description: Use when you need to discover arXiv e-prints by keyword, title, author or field query: pass any arXiv search_query string (e.g. "transformer attention", "au:vaswani", "ti:\"attention is all you need\"", "cat:cs.LG AND all:diffusion"). Returns up to 25 papers with id, title, summary, authors (names + affiliation without emails), primary category, categories, published/updated, comment, journal ref, DOI, abs and PDF URLs, plus totalResults for paging. Sort by relevance, lastUpdatedDate or submittedDate. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.003 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.
name: arxiv_search
title: ScrapeMole Arxiv: arXiv paper search and metadata for AI agents: arXiv paper search
